claims.text: Single-language BERT models perform better than multilingual BERT in tasks assessing agreement relations, achieving above 80% accuracy.
BERT's performance on syntactic structure tasks is high, indicating that single-language models can effectively capture linguistic phenomena compared to multilingual models.
The performance of BERT varies by language, suggesting that single-language models may be better suited for specific linguistic tasks than multilingual models.
